book_name: 黎平钝频白蚁 Ahmaditermes lipingerzsis
en: Only the soldier caste is treated. The head is yellowish brown, the nasus reddish brown, the thorax, abdomen and legs pale yellow tinged with brown, and the front half of the pronotum darker. Setae are very sparse: two long ones stand behind the vertex, the nasus carries short hairs on its front half and apex, and the abdominal tergites bear fine pubescence with occasional long hairs. The small soldier resembles the large one but is shorter, with a head as long as broad and 12 antennal segments.
soldier: 头褐黄，象鼻褐中带赤，触角黄褐，胸部、腹部与足淡黄带褐，前胸背板前半部褐色。头毛极稀，头顶后方仅有长毛两根；象鼻前半部与端部短毛较多，鼻基另有少量短毛；腹部背板微毛较多，各节后缘间或杂生数根长毛。小兵蚁与大型兵蚁颇为相似，仅体形较小，头长略大于宽或长宽近于相等，触角十二节。
